# SKETCH REVISION READY — BUG-1802 and BUG-1808 v2

State: revised sketches authored and published, AWAITING INDEPENDENT ADVISOR SIGNOFF. This author provides no approval, implementation or merge. Root must dispatch a DIFFERENT independent advisor. Final authority-changing merge belongs only to the operator.

Source baseline: main 199e591b07aa76a59cd34f0a41946f918501f6ba. Authoritative CLI: /home/joe/ai/aida/target/agent/aida. Full BUG-1802/BUG-1808 and TASK-1337 specs/comments read. Both independent CHANGES REQUESTED verdicts in INDEPENDENT_SKETCH_SIGNOFF.md are binding; no operator fork or acceptance relaxation is proposed.

Published full-text comments (exact JSON readback verified):

- BUG-1802: `/home/joe/ai/aida/.aida/handoff/orchestrator/BUG-1802-sketch-v2.md`; comment `01a11966-fa04-7bd1-860e-02dc758abfc3`; SHA256 `c717523b533db5e9282cac6c10d1b27f585b6d6fec207ddac6bae9a0d03a342c`.
- BUG-1808: `/home/joe/ai/aida/.aida/handoff/orchestrator/BUG-1808-sketch-v2.md`; comment `01a11967-1add-7ad1-a922-0b833f2cd980`; SHA256 `8331ac0d702c93a1ba457e2b68b05172b78d56dbbbb5fa62f53c957cd0448847`.

BUG-1802 addresses retained grant/manifest/process joins, stable actors across reissue/resume, complete per-commit DAG coverage and imported/rewrite lineage, unknown legacy refusal without fresh-review laundering, actual reviewer ancestry/record-time authority, typed invalid candidates, canonical serialized rounds, CI/handshake transport and every ship/drain/corpus/refusal-release boundary. New coverage is explicitly per-session evidence and commit/rewrite hook integration, not an invented global provenance ledger. Reviewer expiry/revocation and historical closure policy remain binding.

BUG-1808 names one issuance owner per path, token/member/phase/attempt/grant/session joins, shared in-process phase preparation followed by direct assigned vendor launch (avoiding a second setup/refusal boundary), TUI/setup-only and rework-prefix handling. It chooses one journaled staged publication protocol with final authorization linearization, enlisted authority/lifecycle readers and writers, ordered locks, exact locked preimages, private Git/ref preparation, expiry and crash recovery. This requires a bounded new publication module/staging adapter and writer enlistment: the baseline does not already provide atomicity. An implementation without that scope cannot claim strict unchanged-state acceptance. No residual-state exception is proposed.

Both sketches name real CLI argv and proposed regression witnesses, including deterministic authority/peer races, malformed approval, retained history, no duplicate issuance and actual production phase launch. No tests or live reproductions were run. The independent reviewer must assess the concrete design and necessary bounded infrastructure; the author has not judged its own sketch approved.

Previous artifacts preserved:

- `BUG-1802-sketch.md` SHA256 `4c45b382af4eadfd98abe2d9f2746c0c95e03818e0a711bbb48c0c0443b29b82`.
- `BUG-1808-sketch.md` SHA256 `0ca9d97e78b7308e411d9dabca88c1f08322b85563abadfe398437cbb8bfe3d0`.
- `INDEPENDENT_SKETCH_SIGNOFF.md` SHA256 `cc65c20c388c22b9c73f76cbdc4febd516331245c90cf8a18a0124c24fe07a27`.
- `SKETCH_AUTHOR_READY.md` SHA256 `b4331fb1cdfc4e2536b9fe01bc33e7e6fa80115623d15c8a95f8756795c307bf`.

Both spec statuses remain Approved; prior comments, description, history and queue membership match the pre-publication reads. Only the two v2 files, this ready handoff, two authorized spec comments and the advisor mailbox notification are authored. No source edits, code commits/pushes, grants, queues, status/hold changes, worktree changes, merge, live peer/user-store experiments, or signoff. Original main untracked files and previous handoffs remain untouched. Spec comments necessarily update the AIDA store through the supported CLI.

Publication note: the CLI advertises a generic --format option but comment add rejects --format json before execution. Retried with supported --format toon; each v2 body exists exactly once and was verified with show --format json. No approval-review rejection occurred.

Next action: root dispatches a different independent advisor to review both v2 artifacts against the pinned source and both binding verdicts, then records signoff or concrete requested changes. Do not implement or proxy-merge based on this readiness handoff.
